steps: Define which user events count as valid and good.
SLI computes the observed performance over a window.
SLO sets the internal reliability target for that indicator.
SLA codifies an external commitment and consequence.

lesson.scenario: A checkout team separates measured availability, its engineering objective, and the contractual customer commitment.

steps.title: Define eligible events
steps.narration: The SLI excludes synthetic probes and client-cancelled requests, counting a request good when status is non-5xx and latency is under 800 ms.

steps.narration: The external SLA promises 99.5 percent and service credits; it is looser than the 99.90 percent engineering SLO.
steps.outcome: The team can miss its SLO before breaching customer contracts.
